title: fix(spec): the owner-stamp build door judges a packages[] artifact's top level the way the boot does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9J4iPJLcsx6kVWHxTPk6cwZ)_
Fixes #28695

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the build door stops refusing shapes the boot accepts: a foreign-stamped top-level seed dataset, `datasets` entry or job of a `packages[]` artifact, and a top-level copy of a body's view container spelled with another binding. The one shape it now refuses that it accepted before (a top-level list-bound container no body declares, wearing a foreign stamp, while a body carries any list-bound container) is one the boot already refused, and the pending build-door changeset for item stamps already declares it refused.
Metadata-protocol: added (a foreign `_packageId` on a top-level `data`, `datasets` or `jobs` item of a `packages[]` artifact, and on a top-level copy of a body's view container, is accepted at the build doors as it is at boot)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`defineStack` / `os validate` / `os build` 对多包制品(`packages[]`)顶层"残余项"的 `_packageId` 判定，改成和启动时 `unclaimedTopLevel` 完全同一套认领规则;另补 30 个逐集合的构建侧钉子和一行文档。
- **为什么改**:构建门和启动门对"哪些顶层项算残余"判法不一：顶层 seed `data`、`datasets`、`jobs` 构建拒、启动收;视图容器按名字认领，换一种绑定写法就误判(两个方向都有)。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 spec 里一个私有校验函数，无导出、无键变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。唯一新拒的形状启动本来就拒。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`(`isResidualTopLevelItem` 与 `TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL`)、`packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts`(两门等价钉)、`.changeset/28695-owner-stamp-residual-walk.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts`,应见 27 个用例全绿(在 main 上是 11 红)。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地(落地前需一次契约复审档复核，由席位转交分诊)。

## What changes

**S1: the residual walk.** `applyCollectionItemOwnerStampGate` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) judges a `packages[]` stack's top level through a new private predicate, `isResidualTopLevelItem`, that mirrors the boot's residual rule (`unclaimedTopLevel` / `artifactItemSlot` / `claimedArtifactSlots`, `@objectstack/metadata`), which spec cannot import:

- top-level `data`, `datasets` and `jobs` are never residual (`TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL`). The boot's rule walks only the collections the metadata door registers as items, and these three are not among them; `AppPlugin` seeds, consumes and schedules them off the stack whole, judging no stamp. A package body's items of these collections are still judged at both doors;
- an aggregated view container's slot is the object it binds to (`deriveViewContainerObject`: own `object`, then `list.data.object`, then `form.data.object`, then `name`), and a body's container also claims each view it expands into (`expandViewContainer`). Any other item's slot is its `name`; an item with no slot is not judged, since no door registers it.

The single-package branch and the body judgement are unchanged.

**Measured against the card's mechanism assumption.** Seed `data` held: refused at build, accepted at boot. **Picklists did not hold:** the boot's rule lists a residual picklist, and the metadata door registers it under `manifest.id` and refuses a foreign stamp on it (`registerUnclaimedTopLevel` → `registerArtifactBodyCollections`, measured in the new metadata pin). Skipping picklists would have made the build door looser than the boot, so the build door keeps judging them. Measuring the whole list showed two more collections in the `data` class: `datasets` and `jobs`, which the boot's rule does not walk either.

**S3: build-side pins key by key.** `stack-collection-item-owner-stamp.test.ts` gains one pin per member of `OWNER_STAMP_JUDGED_COLLECTIONS`, iterated from the constant, with a fixture table typed as a `Record` keyed by `OwnerStampJudgedCollection` (a new member does not compile until it has a fixture) and a test holding the table's keys equal to the constant. Each pin requires the unstamped stack to parse, then exactly one custom issue at `KEY.INDEX._packageId` for a foreign stamp, and none for a stamp equal to `manifest.id`.

**The equality pin.** `packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts` is where both rules are reachable. For every judged collection, a foreign-stamped top-level item no body declares: the build door raises the issue exactly when `unclaimedTopLevel` lists the item, and `MetadataPlugin.registerUnclaimedTopLevel` refuses exactly those. A 5 × 5 matrix of body/top-level view container spellings holds the same equality.

**S4: docs.** One row in the doors table of `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` for the owner-stamp refusal. The connectors failure-mode row (`content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`) was read and left as is: its sentence ("an entry carrying a `_packageId` other than its own package's is refused at the install") is about the install door, and it is true there.

## Tests

- New tests only. No existing test was edited (no forced test edits).
- `packages/spec/src/stack-collection-item-owner-stamp.test.ts`: +31 (S3, 30 collections + table/constant equality) and +6 (S1 residual walk).
- `packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts`: new, 27 tests.

## Acceptance notes

- S2 (`apps` at the residual door) rode #28697, as ruled; `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` is untouched.
- The pending changeset `.changeset/28627-item-owner-stamp-build-door.md` still says "a top-level item no body declares judged against `manifest.id`" without the `data` / `datasets` / `jobs` exception. Not edited here (editing another PR's pending changeset reds Check Changeset by design); this PR's own changeset states the exception, and both ship in the same release notes.
- A foreign `_packageId` on a top-level `data`, `datasets` or `jobs` item of a `packages[]` stack is now judged at no door. Nothing reads a stamp on those three today (they are applied or scheduled straight off the stack), so it is noted here, not filed.
